_doc: UI-test av kortet Finished model i The Character Creator (studio/human.js, tools/character/human/make_final.py): syssling_wrap20 (inpassad, med bakad normalkarta och en färdig modell) öppnas, kortet förväljer den senaste normalkartan och listar den färdiga modellen, flödets sista steg pekar på den, och knappen bygger en ny syssling_wrap20_final_v<n>.glb med alla kontroller och visar den. Ta bort assets/characters/syssling_wrap20/syssling_wrap20_final_v* efteråt. Kör mot studio-test: url med port 8771.
name: creator_final

steps.eval: (() => { const c = [...document.querySelectorAll('#huside .card')].find((x) => x.querySelector('h2')?.textContent === 'Finished model'); window.__fin = c; return { selects: [...c.querySelectorAll('select')].map((s) => s.value), rows: c.querySelectorAll('.hu-bakedrow').length, msg: c.querySelector('.note').textContent }; })()

steps.label: the card preselects the newest detail normal map and the even skin colour
the finished model is listed with its checks ok
the flow's last step is partly done (a finished model without a colour map)
the button builds a new finished GLB with all checks ok and lists it

steps.expect: (() => { let n = 0, t = 0; __studio.human.figure.traverse((o) => { if (o.isMesh && o.material?.normalMap) n++; if (o.isSkinnedMesh) t++; }); return n > 0 && t > 0; })()
steps.label: the view shows the finished model, skinned and with its normal map
